name: claude-code-monitor
description: 🇨🇳 Claude Code 实时状态栏监控 | 🇬🇧 Real-time status bar monitor for Claude Code — model, context, rate, TTFT, retry detection, multi-session

commands.title: Claude Code: Select Session to Monitor

claudeCodeMonitor.projectsDir.markdownDescription: Override the Claude Code projects directory (defaults to `~/.claude/projects`). Leave empty to use the default.

claudeCodeMonitor.contextLimit.markdownDescription: Model context window size in tokens, used to compute the context-usage percentage.

claudeCodeMonitor.refreshIntervalMs.markdownDescription: Poll interval (ms) for refreshing status from the transcript.

claudeCodeMonitor.retryThresholdMs.markdownDescription: If a request stays in-flight longer than this, it is flagged as possibly retrying / timed out.

claudeCodeMonitor.showInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the live status bar item.

claudeCodeMonitor.maxHistoryRequests.markdownDescription: How many recent requests to keep for the dashboard sparkline / history table.
